data.grouping: Whole trials and identifiable stimulus groups across sessions; isolate development overlap with oracle before seed-42 grouping
data.unresolved_source_identity: Content matching does not establish unseen source films

preprocessing.behavior: x / train standard deviation; no mean subtraction
preprocessing.responses: x times train precision; no mean subtraction or clipping; retain source near-zero numerical negatives
preprocessing.source_statistics_policy: Never read historical all or official-train statistics for learned transforms

training.trainer_validation_alias: oracle contains only new validation trial IDs
training.resume: This run's complete epoch-boundary state only, with protocol, split, preprocessing, architecture and seed guards

response_matching.summary: Mean per-neuron Pearson correlation across validation trial and time samples; no repeats required
response_matching.interpretation: Fixed output perturbation; not separately trained matched models
response_matching.failed_test_match: Q1 matched-accuracy interpretation is inconclusive; retain main comparisons

reporting.uncertainty_unit: Movie condition, paired within the pilot session
reporting.response_summary: Mean per-neuron Pearson correlation on identical trial/time support
reporting.five_session_summary: Report each session and their unweighted mean; do not pool trajectory evidence across sessions
reporting.undefined: NA with reason and support; no zero replacement
reporting.historical_oracle_exposure: Oracle was explored in Parts 1 and 2; this is not virgin external validation
